reader_summary.headline: Sanjay Ayer is a portfolio manager at WCM Investment Management.
reader_summary.overview: Sanjay Ayer is a portfolio manager at WCM Investment Management, the Laguna-based $80 billion equity manager profiled on three popular past episodes with CEO Paul Black. Sanjay joined WCM in 2007, and alongside Mike Trigg, leads the firm's research process that follows the mantra: think different and get better. Our conversation is a fascinating exploration of the differentiated mindset at WCM.

key_points.text: Sanjay Ayer is a portfolio manager at WCM Investment Management.
We discuss topics, including self-discovery, cognitive dissonance, thinking differently, getting better, compounding knowledge, reflection time.
